subject: Evening interview rotation — delegate chain & slot coverage
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evening interview rotation — delegate chain & slot coverage

Hey team,

We've got a compact interview slate for the Senior Infra position next week with several candidates requesting evening slots (6–9pm PT) because they're relocating. I want to put together a short delegate chain so we can: (1) ensure every slot has two interviewers where possible, (2) identify who will accept on short notice if someone drops, and (3) keep debriefs within 2 hours of the interview.

Current constraints: I have three confirmed evenings (Tue/Wed/Thu 6:30–8:00pm PT) but only one backup for each. Can you reply with: A) which evening slots you can take as primary, B) whether you can be a 30-minute immediate backup (on-call), and C) whether you can host the debrief within 60–120 minutes after the last interviewer?

I've attached Alex Zhao's resumé and an availability grid I pulled from Recruiting Ops; please update the grid if you take a slot (column: name). I'll consolidate and send calendar shares to the candidate and Recruiting.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager, GTM
Redwood Inference

On Fri, May 28, 2027 at 9:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hey team,
> 
> We've got a compact interview slate for the Senior Infra position next week with several candidates requesting evening slots (6–9pm PT) because they're relocating.

Thanks for starting this, Ben — added my availability to the attached grid (evening-availability-grid.csv). Quick notes:
- I can cover Tue 6:30–7:30pm as primary and be a 30-minute backup on Wed.
- I can host debriefs up to 90 minutes after the slot ends, but prefer 60 if possible.
- For Thu I recommend we bring in Lauren as primary and Jonas as secondary (she's been on similar interviews).

@Recruiting Ops — please confirm candidate is okay with back-to-back debrief windows; Alex has limited availability but indicated some flexibility for debriefs.

I'll update GH record GH-12456 once Ben confirms final roster.

Cheers,
Marissa

--

Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening interview rotation — delegate chain & slot coverage

Thanks — I can take Wed 7:00–8:30pm as primary and be on-call for Tue if anything changes.

One operational suggestion: let's define a single debrief owner per candidate (rotating) who will collect feedback and run the quick rubric so we don't end up with staggered notes. I can be the debrief owner for Alex if Marissa hosts Tue. I'll use the debrief-rubric-v2.md (attached) and post a short summary to the GH ticket.

Also, if someone is late or misses a slot, the delegate chain should escalate like this: Primary -> Secondary -> On-call (30m backup) -> Recruiting Ops. Would be great to confirm that chain so Recruiting can notify candidates pro-actively.

— Jonas

--

Hi all,

Alex confirms Tue/Wed/Thu evenings work, prefers Tue or Wed. Candidate asked that debriefs be kept within 2 hours when possible. We've tentatively held Tue 6:30–7:30pm PT on the candidate's calendar pending final confirmation.

Attachment: resume-alex-zhao.pdf (candidate submitted), note: candidate timezone PST. If you need us to page additional interviewers from the contractor pool we can do that, but please approve before we surface contractor names to the candidate.

Thanks,
Recruiting Ops

Thanks everyone — plan below (finalizing and will update GH and calendar invites):
- Tue 6:30–7:30pm PT: Marissa (primary), Jonas (secondary). Debrief owner: Jonas, to run rubric and post summary to GH-12456 within 90 minutes.
- Wed 7:00–8:30pm PT: Jonas (primary), Marissa (on-call backup). Debrief owner: Marissa, 60–90 minute window.
- Thu 6:30–8:00pm PT: Lauren (primary), Mina (secondary). Debrief owner: Lauren.
- On-call escalation chain: Primary -> Secondary -> On-call (first person listed as backup) -> Recruiting Ops.

@Alex — confirming Tue 6:30pm works? If yes, Recruiting will send final invite.

Attachments: evening-availability-grid.csv (updated), debrief-rubric-v2.md (final).
